dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Trailing edge exhibits a deep concave spline fitting, heavily modified by a large, irregular excision at the midpoint of the vertical height.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Large pixel radius resulting in a rounded, obtuse apex morphology.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Convex anterior margin with a steep angle of approximately 50 degrees relative to the posterior-anterior body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: The visible horizontal base-to-height ratio is approximately 2.2:1.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent deep triangular notch in the upper trailing edge; smaller rectangular notch further down the trailing edge; multiple white punctate scars and linear nicks along the anterior margin; large irregular white depigmentation patch on the upper leading edge flank.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly irregular and jagged silhouette of the visible dorsal ridge extending posteriorly from the fin base.
